text: Handling deadlines effectively is a crucial skill in both academic and professional settings. Good time management starts with breaking large tasks into smaller, manageable steps and setting personal milestones before the final due date. Prioritization helps you focus on the most urgent or important tasks first, using tools like to-do lists to stay organized. Scope management involves being realistic about what you can achieve; if a project becomes too large, adjust expectations rather than rush. Finally, communication is key—if you foresee a delay, inform your team or supervisor early, as honesty builds trust and allows for solutions. By combining these strategies, you can meet deadlines with less stress and better quality.
